name: Nicanor
description: The governor of Cyprus, one of the governors of several places who would not suffer the Jews to be quiet and live in peace after the covenants were made; a different man from the Nicanor whom Demetrius later sent against Judas

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
